notes: συναποθανεῖν σοι -> 'die with thee' gave the English 'with' to the verb as its σύν- element. The chapter's four other compound-verb-plus-dative units (14.5, 14.46, 14.53, 14.65) give such a preposition to the governed pronoun under rules 21 and 36, and the corpus aligns σοι -> 'with thee' as one unit headed on the pronoun at EPH.6.3 and JHN.2.4. Moved 'with' to σοι.
